final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Object-layer scan of namespace boutique: all 11 pods freshly created (~91s) with RESTARTS=0; the only outlier is checkoutservice-757c84f65-48bhl 0/1 Running (deployment checkoutservice 0/1 AVAILABLE), all other workloads 1/1. Pod events (kubelet, verbatim): 'Warning Unhealthy 10s (x9 over 80s) Readiness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.2.125:5051" within 1s: context deadline exceeded'; no liveness failure, no Killing, no 137/143 termination -> OOM/low-memory and liveness restarts excluded. Container logs show the app listens on only one port: 'starting to listen on tcp: "[::]:5050"'. GetAppYAML confirms the break: readinessProbe grpc port 5051 while containerPort=5050, env PORT=5050, livenessProbe grpc port 5050 and Service targetPort 5050 (all self-consistent at 5050). Endpoints listing shows checkoutservice with NO endpoints while every other Service has one, i.e. the pod never becomes Ready and is removed from the Service. All nodes Ready with no pressure, excluding node-level causes. Root cause: readiness probe points at port 5051 instead of the actual service port 5050.
